Eight persons — P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W — were born in eight different months of the same year, from January to December, but not necessarily in the same order. No two persons were born in the same month, so four months have no birthday.

6. U was born in March.
7. Less than two persons were born between V and S.
8. W was born three months after Q.
9. P was born two months after W.
10. No one was born in the month immediately before the month in which U was born.
11. P was born in one of the months after October.

Final arrangement: January – R, February – —, March – U, April – —, May – —, June – —, July – Q, August – V, September – S, October – W, November – T, December – P.
